name: ABAW 2020 (Aff-Wild2)
description: The Affective Behavior Analysis in-the-wild (ABAW) 2020 Competition is the first Competition aiming at automatic analysis of the three main behavior tasks of valence-arousal estimation, basic expression recognition and action unit detection. It is split into three Challenges, each one addressing a respective behavior task. For the Challenges, we provide a common benchmark database, Aff-Wild2, which is a large scale in-the-wild database and the first one annotated for all these three tasks. In this paper, we describe this Competition, to be held in conjunction with the IEEE Conference on Face and Gesture Recognition, May 2020, in Buenos Aires, Argentina. We present the three Challenges, with the utilized Competition corpora. We outline the evaluation metrics, present both the baseline system and the top-3 performing teams' methodologies per Challenge and finally present their obtained results. More information regarding the Competition, the leaderboard of each Challenge and details for accessing the utilized database, are provided in the Competition site: http://ibug.doc.ic.ac.uk/resources/fg-2020-competition-affective-behavior-analysis.
evaluation_method: Task-specific metrics: Concordance Correlation Coefficient (CCC) for valence-arousal regression; F1 and accuracy for basic expression recognition; F1 for action unit detection
general_score_metric: Task-specific (CCC for valence-arousal; F1 / accuracy for expressions and action units); competitions sometimes report combined/weighted scores across tasks
typical_sota_score: varies by task — expression recognition ~60–75% (F1/accuracy), action unit detection ~40–60% (F1), valence-arousal CCC ~0.3–0.6
reputation: Well-known and widely used benchmark in the affective-computing/emotion-recognition community with established leaderboards and baseline systems.
notes: In-the-wild dataset with class imbalance and label noise; multi-task evaluation across heterogeneous metrics; non-LLM benchmark focused on vision-based affective behavior analysis.
